description: The DS1054Z is a four-channel bench digital oscilloscope. It draws voltage signals as waveforms over time on a 7-inch colour screen. In a makerspace it is used to debug and check electronics projects, such as microcontroller outputs, PWM, sensor signals, power-supply ripple and serial buses. It can watch four signals at once and has automatic measurements, an FFT view and USB/LAN ports for saving or remote control, so it suits both learning and real troubleshooting.

specs.label: Analog bandwidth (-3 dB)
specs.value: DC to 50 MHz (calculated rise time 7 ns)

specs.label: Max real-time sample rate
specs.value: 1 GSa/s (1 channel), 500 MSa/s (2 channels), 250 MSa/s (3 or 4 channels)

specs.label: Memory depth
specs.value: Up to 24 Mpts (1 channel); 6 Mpts with 3 or 4 channels

specs.label: Max input voltage (1 MΩ)
specs.value: CAT I 300 Vrms, CAT II 100 Vrms, 1000 Vpk transient

specs.label: Power
specs.value: 100 V to 240 V AC, 45 Hz to 440 Hz, 50 W max

materials: Digital and serial signals (e.g. UART, I2C, SPI)
useRestrictions: Rated for Measurement Category I only. Do not connect it to mains-powered circuits, and never clip the probe ground lead to anything but circuit ground, because the probe ground is tied to earth through the scope.
